chunk_findings.detail: `_run_locked` and `_run_under_slot` now unpack three values from `_execute` (`p, out_prefix, elapsed = _execute(...)`), and the new docstring says the third is elapsed seconds summed across stages, but the only body change is `spent = p.elapsed_s` before the selected-scope stage. That name is never added to, never returned, and the following hunk ends at `scope.unran = unran`, so the real return is still the old 2-tuple. A normal `ddflow ci run` (full suite or selected) therefore raises `ValueError: not enough values to unpack` before `_settled_result` can set `elapsed_s`, so timed outcomes are not recorded at all. Even if a later return used `spent`, it is snapshotted on the pre-selection process only, so a selected run's second stage would not be included in the sum the comment claims.
